summary: The filing is an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) by Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. announcing its participation in the LD Micro Invitational XVI investor conference, where CEO Steve Reinharz will present on May 18, 2026. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 describes the company's AI-driven security platform and its focus on recurring monthly revenue. No material corporate transaction or special situation is disclosed. The filing is a routine notice of an investor event, not a special situation.
